# Tailored Furniture

> Filipino-owned, family-run maker of custom, made-to-measure furniture. Founded in August 1995 as AGP Furniture & Interiors, later renamed Tailored Furniture. Builds for homes, hotels, restaurants, offices and institutions, and for interior designers' and architects' client projects.

## Contact
- Phone and Viber: +63 949 455 7524
- Email: tailoredfurnph@gmail.com
- Facebook and Instagram: @tailoredfurnph
- Website: https://tailoredfurn.com/

## Services
- Customized furniture (residential, restaurant, office)
- Hotel furnishings
- Outdoor furniture
- Interior fit-out
- Modular cabinets
- Refinishing, refurbishing and reupholstery
- Interior design consultation and renovation

## How a project starts
- Free room blueprint for homes: the client describes one room (about 2 minutes online), a designer draws it to scale with pieces sized to fit and a quote for each, ready in 3 working days, then reviews it on a 15-minute call.
- Trade Program for interior designers and architects: furniture built to the designer's drawings, shop drawings for approval before production, one coordinator per project, progress photos, a finish sample kit and a workshop tour.
- Hotels and restaurants: a cost-per-seat calculator and a site visit with sample chairs.
- Offices and clinics: a free space-planning visit for teams of 10 or more.
- Existing furniture: a check on whether to restore (refinish, refurbish, reupholster) or replace a piece.

## Service area
Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas (Philippines). Clients elsewhere can enquire.

## Selected projects
- Ascott Makati (hotel)
- Girasol Tagaytay (restaurant: dining hall with curved booths, cane-back chairs, private wine room)
- Ecoverde Development (office)
- Immanuel Diagnostics, Nasugbu (clinic)
- Private residences across Metro Manila (living rooms, bedrooms, dining rooms)
